mentions.name: GameSieve
mentions.description: This service is an alternative front-end, game discovery service, and price tracker for GOG's catalog. It enhances GOG API data mostly via heuristics with some manual effort, offers a wider range of filters, and groups related products together for a more complete overview. It supports library import that recognizes games GOG fails to credit, such as those obtained as freebies or through since-delisted deluxe editions, and is extending incomplete "series" listings to include all relevant games.
mentions.problem: GOG doesn't recognize that users own certain games obtained as freebies or as part of since-delisted deluxe editions, and its catalog lacks complete related-product grouping, rich filtering, and complete series listings.
mentions.source_excerpt: An alternative front-end / game discovery service / price tracker for GOG's catalog. Mostly manually enhancing the data from the API (90% heuristics, 10% human effort, as the total dataset isn't large enough for it to be worth doing otherwise), and offering a wider range of filters for it all.

evidence.value: An alternative front-end / game discovery service / price tracker for GOG's catalog. Mostly manually enhancing the data from the API (90% heuristics, 10% human effort, as the total dataset isn't large enough for it to be worth doing otherwise), and offering a wider range of filters for it all.
